gorgecafe_cook.text: Walkers, climbers, goat watchers, everyone ends up here. The gorge makes people hungry.
The cliffs rise to about 137 metres, which makes this the biggest gorge in Britain.
Wild goats and Soay sheep live on the cliffs. Do not offer them a sandwich, they will take the whole bag.

then.text: Back for another flask? You have a very thirsty cliff in front of you, I see.

else.text: Take a flask of tea for the climb. Bring the flask back if you remember.
